$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-approval-card).

Body.$why: Figma draws the rule above the body and the footer as a separate 1 px Separator; the code draws it as the part's top border, so the part is 1 px taller (the card's size is compared). With a preview, Figma pads the body 8 px and wraps the text in an 8 px frame (Summary) so the text sits 16 px in and the preview 8 px; the code pads the body 16 px and pulls the preview out 8 px.

Summary.$why: Figma's Summary frame adds the 8 px the body lacks (see Body); in code the text is the body's own 16 px in.

Preview.$why: Figma stacks the lines 2 px apart inside 8 px padding; the code's <pre> uses a 2 px taller line and 1 px less padding, which puts every line in the same place (the size is compared).

Preview/TEXT.$why: See Preview: the line is 18 px so the 2 px between Figma's lines is part of it.

Details.$why: Figma's Details frame hugs its rows; the code's grid fills the body so long values wrap. The 6 px between rows is the grid's row gap (and 12 px its column gap), which the gap check cannot read as one number.

Footer.$why: Figma draws the rule above the body and the footer as a separate 1 px Separator; the code draws it as the part's top border, so the part is 1 px taller (the card's size is compared).
